title: Recursive NAND on addressed inputs
statement: For every natural number $d$ and every sign assignment $x$ to the $2^d$ coordinates, the depth-$d$ recursive NAND equals the depth-$d$ address-recursive NAND on the assignment that gives each formula address the value of $x$ at the corresponding coordinate under the canonical bijection between the $2^d$ coordinates and depth-$d$ formula addresses of arity two.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ assigns a sign to each of the $2^d$ coordinates
